recipient-org.narrative: Yayasan Bani Abdurrahman Wahid (YBAW) is Civil Society Organizations in Indonesia established since 2011 until present. On 2021 The state of the Netherlands, represented by the Minister Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation contribution to YBAW for run the program BEST (Beda dan Setara: Different yet Equal): Program Empowering Youth and Religious Actors to Promote Tolerance and Diversity in Indonesia.

recipient-country.narrative: The program will be held in 6 regions in Indonesia West Java, East Java, Central Java, Yogyakarta, Sulawesi, and Kalimantan
